**Get it on [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/cardealersimulator/mods/56)**, or download `LukasMods-CDS-SteamAchievements-1.0.1.zip` below. Same file, sha256 `dfad39a9df5d10df4260bad38466e3f424dc7233754d8c471b3873d6154f0b71`.

Every Steam achievement in the game, in an app on your tablet and office computer, and up to 4 tracked on a small HUD panel that updates the moment you make progress. It reads your progress and never unlocks anything.

Needs the Steam version of the game and an **EXPERIMENTAL** build of UE4SS: [the one on Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/cardealersimulator/mods/53) is tested. No DLC needed. Using Vortex? Set Car Dealer Simulator to be managed by Vortex and drop the zip in: it installs the mod, and UE4SS if it's missing. Install and full details: [Steam Achievements guide](https://github.com/lukas-mods/Lukas-Mods/blob/main/guides/car-dealer-simulator/steam-achievements.md).

> ⚠️ **Use at Your Own Risk.** Any mod can crash a game or damage a save, so back up your saves first (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\CarDealerSimulator\Saved\`).

## 1.0.1

- Debug logging is off by default, so UE4SS.log stays shorter.
- Tidied the source code comments.

## 1.0 - First Release

- An app on the tablet and the office computer listing all 203 achievements: progress, tiers, and how many Steam players have each one.
- Filters (All, Tracked, In Progress, Done) and a search box.
- Track up to 4 achievements on a HUD panel; with nothing tracked, it suggests the 4 easiest.
- Live progress: counts move the moment the game reports them.
- Hidden achievements stay hidden until unlocked.
